title: A Timeline of Gracie Abrams & Paul Mescal’s Relationship
summary: The couple first sparked romance rumors in 2024.
body: Gracie Abrams and Paul Mescal have one of the buzziest romances in the entertainment industry, with the couple’s history going back years before they first stepped out in public together in 2024. Even before the singer-songwriter became one of the biggest names in pop music, the Irish actor was a documented fan of her music — but more on that later. In the years since they first interacted online, they’ve both worked hard on building their careers and rising to the top of their respective fields, with Abrams charting a number of hits on the Billboard Hot 100 and Mescal starring in major blockbusters such as Aftersun, All of Us Strangers and Gladiator II . As for their personal lives, the California native was briefly linked to DJ Hayes Bradely, while Mescal was in a longterm relationship with — and reportedly engaged to — singer Phoebe Bridgers. Though they chose to keep their relationship totally out of public view for the first year or so, Abrams and Mescal eventually started to feel more comfortable attending events together and sharing adorable photos with each other on social media. title: I won’t ever leave the country without the Timekettle X1 Meeting Interpreter Hub translator
summary: Jump over any language barrier with this business-tier translation hub.
body: It is said that the Tower of Babel signified the limitless capabilities of human unity and ambition. Truly, language is one of the biggest barriers, but modern technology is breaking it down. AI, translation apps, and certain devices are more accessible and easy to use than ever. Enter the Timekettle X1 Meeting, a device that promises to make multi-language meetings and general translation simple, even when offline. I’ve seen Timekettle translators for some years, usually at technology conventions like CES, which is a pretty good place for them, given the usual mass of multilingual attendees at such events. I always wondered how well they worked outside of such showcases; testing them for a few minutes on the show floor certainly isn’t enough to form an opinion.
